name: Clipboard History & Managers
shortDesc: Keeps history of copied text, images, and snippets with quick search modal.
detailedDesc: Small convenience that transforms daily workflow: press Super + V to search and paste previous clips.

phase.title: Desktop QoL & Ricing Utilities
phase.description: The fine-grained ricing details: clipboard managers, color pickers, screenshot annotation, polkit, portals, and fonts.

packages.name: cliphist + wl-clipboard (Recommended)
packages.description: Wayland clipboard manager that stores text, images, and binary clips. Integrates seamlessly into Walker or Rofi fuzzy launchers.
pros: Supports both rich text and PNG/JPEG image previews
cons: Requires a launcher frontend to display history UI

packages.name: clipse (TUI Clipboard Manager)
packages.description: Keyboard-driven standalone TUI clipboard manager built in Go. Pops up in a small floating terminal scratchpad.
cons: Requires configuring a floating terminal window rule

packages.name: clipman
packages.description: Simple, lightweight clipboard manager for Wayland focused purely on text snippets.
cons: Does not preserve image clipboard data
